description: KDIGO urine-output arm: additional AKI captured beyond the creatinine-only definition (ICU subset).

rules.sensitive: any charted 6-h block < 0.5 mL/kg/h (UPPER bound; inflated by sparse charting + transient dips)
rules.conservative: full 24-h charting (all 4 blocks) AND >= 2 low blocks (>= 12 h low) (specific LOWER bound)

caveats: ICU intime-anchored window vs hosp admittime-anchored creatinine label
urine limb computable only for admissions with an ICU stay

interpretation: The creatinine-only AKI definition omits the urine limb entirely. Under the conservative (>=12 h sustained, fully-charted) rule, the KDIGO urine criterion flags 6253 additional AKI cases in the ICU subset with no qualifying creatinine rise (+37.0% over creatinine-positives). Even this lower-bound estimate shows the administrative/creatinine label materially under-counts AKI, so the label-validity gap reported in the paper is conservative.
